hubTrigger.claim: China diesel exports rose about tenfold in the first two months of 2023 as refiners used export quotas.

validation.claim: China clean-product exports surged 171.2% YoY in Jan-Feb to 9.56m tonnes; gasoil exports rose 1005.4% YoY.
Revenue RMB1.618bn, +47.76%; attributable profit RMB406m, +292.67%; ex-item profit +281.92%; operating cash flow +464.29%.
Company attributed revenue growth mainly to sharply higher international product-tanker rates and higher foreign-trade business revenue amid constrained effective capacity.

causalNeighborhood: An export surge matters to a tanker operator through seaborne product volume, distance and freight rates, not simply refinery production.
